result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: truncated restaurant names and cut-off card content on the right side of the page.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section, cutting off the full name
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names have enough space to display fully, or implement text ellipsis with hover tooltips to show complete names

issues.description: The rightmost cards in carousel sections are partially cut off at the screen edge, making content difficult to view
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll or card width to ensure all visible cards are fully displayed, or add padding/margins to accommodate overflow

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' section (with -20% badge) is missing a visible restaurant name label
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards display the business name clearly, either as an overlay or below the image
